info.title: baton-atlassian connector API surface
info.description: OpenAPI description of the Atlassian endpoints baton-atlassian actually calls (pkg/client/client.go). Not the vendor's full API; see .claude/skills/connector/build-openapi-spec.md. baton-atlassian's `--base-url` config override (pkg/client/client.go WithBaseURL) replaces both the admin and lifecycle base URLs in tests; that override is a connector test seam, not a documented vendor server, and is intentionally not modeled here.

servers.description: Atlassian admin API. Used for directory (users/groups), role-assignment, workspace, and API-access-token endpoints.
Atlassian user-management lifecycle API. Used only by the account-deletion endpoint.
Tenant-specific SCIM base URL (includes the SCIM directory ID segment), generated when connecting an identity provider via SCIM provisioning in Atlassian Administration.

scimBaseUrl.description: Full SCIM base URL for the tenant, obtained from Atlassian Administration > Security > SCIM provisioning when connecting an identity provider. Configured in the connector via the `scim-base-url` / `BATON_SCIM_BASE_URL` field. NOTE: baton-atlassian's `--base-url` test override replaces the admin and lifecycle base URLs only; it does not affect this SCIM base URL, which is always configured separately.

get.description: Called from two client.go sites: ListUsers (client.go:158, no groupIds filter) and GetGroupMembers (client.go:128, sets groupIds to one group ID to list that group's members).

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: Atlassian organization ID. From connector config (`organization-id` / `BATON_ORGANIZATION_ID`).

parameters.name: directoryId
parameters.description: Directory ID. The connector always passes the literal `-`, which per the vendor's `directoryIdParam` description means "all directories the requestor has permission to manage".

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor. The connector sets this from the previous page's `links.next` value (WithPageToken). Vendor: opaque cursor token, not a full URL, for the admin v2 directory endpoints.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. The connector caps this at 100 (maxItemsPerPage) via WithPageSize. Vendor default 20, vendor max 100.

parameters.name: groupIds
parameters.description: Filter to users who are members of these group IDs. Only sent by GetGroupMembers (client.go); ListUsers does not send it.

404.description: Organization, directory, or user not found.

get.description: client.go sends the page-size query param as `limit` (via the shared WithPageSize helper), but the vendor spec for this endpoint names that parameter `pageSize` (ApiTokenPageSize), not `limit`; unlike the admin v2 directory endpoints, which do use `limit`. Modeled here as `limit` because that is what the connector actually sends; see the blocker note in the PR provenance table.

post.summary: Suspend a user's access (client-cited endpoint; absent from the current published vendor spec)
post.description: client.go cites https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/admin/organization/rest/api-group-directory/#api-v1-orgs-orgid-directory-users-accountid-suspend-access-post, but the org.json swagger fetched 2026-10-05 does not list this v1 path; it only documents the v2 equivalent, POST /v2/orgs/{orgId}/directories/{directoryId}/users/{accountId}/suspend. Request/response shape is therefore unproven by machine-readable spec; see the blocker note in the PR provenance table. Per client.go comment, cannot be used on organization administrators (returns 400).

servers.description: Atlassian user-management lifecycle API. Used only by the account-deletion endpoint.

post.description: Deletes a managed account across every Atlassian product after a 14-day grace period. model.go APIError reads key/errorDetail/context/message/errors[].code/detail from this endpoint's error bodies; IsAccountNotFound (helper.go) checks key == "accountNotFound" on 404.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the user's account being deleted.

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized to take this action.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist.

409.description: This account isn't eligible for the requested action.

servers.description: Tenant-specific SCIM base URL (includes the SCIM directory ID segment), generated when connecting an identity provider via SCIM provisioning in Atlassian Administration.

scimBaseUrl.description: Full SCIM base URL for the tenant, obtained from Atlassian Administration > Security > SCIM provisioning when connecting an identity provider. Configured in the connector via the `scim-base-url` / `BATON_SCIM_BASE_URL` field. NOTE: baton-atlassian's `--base-url` test override replaces the admin and lifecycle base URLs only; it does not affect this SCIM base URL, which is always configured separately.

post.description: client.go builds the URL as `{scimBaseUrl}/Users` directly (no literal directoryId path segment); the configured scimBaseUrl already embeds the tenant's SCIM directory ID. Vendor's equivalent operation is `createAUserInAnActiveDirectory`, POST /scim/directory/{directoryId}/Users, where `directoryId` is documented as "The SCIM base URL that is generated when connecting an identity provider with SCIM provisioning"; i.e. the same value baton-atlassian stores as scim-base-url.

403.description: You are not authorized to call the API.

orgApiKey.description: Unscoped organization API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Configured via `--access-token` / `BATON_ACCESS_TOKEN`. Used for every admin-API and lifecycle-API operation (uhttp.WithBearerToken(c.config.accessToken) is the doRequest default).

scimToken.description: Per-tenant SCIM bearer token, distinct from the org API key. Configured via `--scim-token` / `BATON_SCIM_TOKEN`. Used only by createUser (client.go passes WithToken(c.config.scimToken)).

Organization.description: client.go: Organization (GetOrganization reads id, type, attributes.name, links.self).

User.description: client.go: User. Vendor MultiDirectoryUser declares no required fields.

LinkPageCursor.description: Pagination links. `next`/`prev`/`self` are opaque cursor tokens for the admin v2 directory endpoints (per vendor LinkPageCursor), not full URLs.

next.description: Cursor to fetch the next page.

prev.description: Cursor to fetch the previous page.

LinkPageURL.description: Pagination links. `next`/`prev`/`self` are full URLs per vendor LinkPageModel (queryWorkspacesV2). client.go passes `links.next` directly back as the request body's `cursor` field on the next call; see the x-source note on ListWorkspaces.

Workspace.description: client.go: Workspace. Vendor WorkspaceModel declares no required fields.

ListWorkspacesRequest.description: client.go ListWorkspaces sends only `cursor`; vendor SearchWorkspacesRequestV2 also accepts query/limit/sort but the connector never sets them. Per vendor docs: when cursor is present, no other properties may be set.

cursor.description: Base-64 encoded continuation token. Empty/omitted on the first page.

Group.description: client.go: Group. Vendor MultiDirectoryGroup declares no required fields.

RoleAssignment.description: client.go: RoleAssignment, shared by GetUserRoleAssignments and GetGroupRoleAssignments. Vendor MultiDirectoryUserRoleAssignment / MultiDirectoryGroupRoleAssignment declare no required fields.

roles.description: Deprecated on the vendor side in favor of roleAssignments, but still the field this connector reads.

resource.description: Workspace ARI. Required by the vendor for all roles other than org-admin; ignored for org-admin.

APIToken.description: client.go: APIToken. Vendor ApiToken requires id, label, status, createdAt, user.

SCIMCreateUserRequest.description: client.go: SCIMCreateUserRequest. Vendor ScimUser has no formal `required` array, but its field descriptions state userName and emails are required during creation.

SCIMUserResponse.description: client.go: SCIMUserResponse. Extension key is the literal SCIM extension URN.

AtlassianAPIError.description: helper.go/model.go: APIError, the generic envelope the connector unmarshals every error response into (doRequest -> uhttp.WithErrorResponse(&apiErr)). It is a superset covering the shapes used across all three base URLs: the directory endpoints return {"errors":[...]}, the org-routing layer returns a flat body whose reason is in "message", and the user-management lifecycle API returns {"key":...,"errorDetail":...}. Used here only where the vendor spec does not give a narrower, operation-specific error schema.

status.description: Vendor docs type this as a string, but model.go decodes it as json.Number because the API has been observed sending a bare numeric status on some error responses; json.Number tolerates either.

key.description: Lifecycle-API error key, e.g. accountNotFound, notFound, conflict.lifecycleErrors.

context.description: A string on lifecycle 403/404, an object with "message" on lifecycle 409.

AdminErrors.description: Vendor org.json component schema `Errors` (used verbatim by getDirectoryUsers, getGroups, getGroup, getUserRoleAssignments, getGroupRoleAssignments).

AdminApplicationErrorsEnvelope.description: Vendor org.json component schema `Errors.ApplicationErrors.Model`, used by assignRole/revokeRole 400/403/404/409.

code.description: ADMIN-UAM-* application error code. ADMIN-UAM-409-2 = Resource Conflicts (helper.go codeAlreadyMember); ADMIN-UAM-409-3 = Product License Limit Exceeded.

AdminApplicationError.description: Vendor org.json component schema `ApplicationError` (singular, not wrapped in an errors[] envelope). Used by queryWorkspacesV2 400/403/404/500.

AdminProxyError.description: Vendor org.json component schema `ProxyError`, used for 401/429 on assignRole/revokeRole/queryWorkspacesV2.

AdminApiErrorResponse.description: Vendor org.json component schema `ApiErrorResponse` (wraps `ApiError`), used for 500 on assignRole/revokeRole.

context.description: Vendor Manageability.Unallowed; fields not declared by model.go (connector reads `context` as a raw/opaque value via json.RawMessage).

LifecycleForbidden.description: Vendor um.json response `Forbidden.Action` (deleteUser 403): discriminated union on `key`.

LifecycleNotFoundAccount.description: Vendor um.json response `NotFound.Account` (deleteUser 404). model.go IsAccountNotFound checks key == "accountNotFound"; the other documented key, "notFound", is not account-specific and propagates as a failure.

key.description: accountNotFound: requested accountId not found. notFound: requested resource not found.
